target.title: Add y-axis tick labels and plot-aware x-axis to cost history chart
target.body: ## Summary Adds dollar-scale y-axis tick labels to the cost history chart and replaces the hand-rolled full-width x-axis `HStack` with Swift Charts' built-in `chartXAxis`, so both axes align to the plot area instead of the container edge. Closes #1854. ## Changes ### Y-axis labels (previously hidden) - `AxisMarks(position: .leading, values: yAxisTickValues(maxCostUSD:))` renders currency-formatted tick labels on the left side. - **Compact formatting**: whole-dollar labels for values ≥ $1 (`$0`, `$757`, `$1,515`), cents preserved only for nonzero sub-dollar values (`$0.50`) to avoid duplicate `$0` ticks. - Empty tick set for flat/no data — the axis renders no labels. - Tick selection: `[]` for ≤ 0, `[0, max]` for < $1, `[0, mid, max]` for ≥ $1. ### X-axis (plot-aware) - Replaced the manual `HStack` (which spanned the full card width and ignored the y-axis gutter) with `chartXAxis { AxisMarks(values: model.axisDates) }`. - Edge labels use explicit anchors: first date `.topLeading`, last date `.topTrailing` — prevents the right-side label from being clipped. - Removed `axisLabelAreaHeight`, `axisLabelTopPadding`, and the manual date `HStack`. Chart height bumped from 114 → 130 to accommodate the built-in axis. ### Detail/tooltip costs unchanged - `yAxisCostString` is chart-local; all detail rows, tooltips, and summary totals still use `UsageFormatter.currencyString` with cents. ## Screenshot ## Video https://cap.so/s/p2506ammwdttz9w ## Testing - 4 new focused tests in `CostHistoryChartMenuViewTests`: - Y-axis tick values: empty for ≤ 0, two ticks < $1, three ticks ≥ $1. - Y-axis cost labels: `$0` for zero, `$13` for 12.56, `$0.50` for sub-dollar nonzero. - `swift test --filter CostHistoryChartMenuViewTests` — 13/13 pass. - `make check` — 0 SwiftFormat/SwiftLint violations. - Full `make test` — passes except one unrelated-by-area failure in `ClaudeOAuthCredentialsStoreCLIStorageOwnershipTests` (OAuth/keychain ownership, not chart code). - Live UI verification via CUA automation confirmed both axis label sets render correctly.
target.author: fndevve
